payload.body: You tend to settle into a routine and then feel compelled to change it, or make a dramatic change and immediately miss the predictability you removed. Neither sameness nor disruption can meet the whole need. This often comes from treating stability as surrender and change as the only proof of independence. Keep one reliable part of the routine while changing the part that actually feels restrictive.
